basics.name: JOSHUA D
basics.label: Creative Technologist & Systems Engineer
basics.sublabel: B.E. Electronics & Communication Engineering | Audio Producer
basics.summary: Driven by intense curiosity and engineering rigor in breaking, building, and optimizing systems. Electronics and Communication Engineering background with deep hands-on expertise in full-stack web architectures, Linux/Unix kernels, Android Automotive OS (AAOS), embedded controllers (CAN / VLSI), reverse engineering, and audio signal processing.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Electronics & Communication Engineering

education.institution: St. Joseph's English Medium High School

highlights: Architecting responsive web interfaces and reusable component systems using React, TypeScript, and modern styling libraries.
Optimized client-side rendering pipelines and asset delivery, improving page load benchmarks and user experience metrics across multiple modules.
Engineered modular table and data-filtering components with aggregation and sorting to handle dense operational data sets.
Developed Cockpit Domain Controller (Luxoft CDC) prototypes supporting CAN bus protocol integration for automotive EC controls.
Explored Android Automotive OS (AAOS) HAL and system services integration for connected vehicle infotainment clusters.
Conducted board-level diagnostics, bootloader unlocking, and custom kernel configurations.
FL Studio Power User specializing in Melodic Techno, Future Bounce, and EDM sound design.
Created custom WebGL audio-reactive visualizers (FFT spectrum analyzers, CRT oscilloscopes, fluid particle smoke shaders).
Engineered spatial sound mixing, stem separation, and audio-reactive digital interactions.
